title: Probability and counting techniques
summary: Probability, Venn diagrams and set notation, the addition rule, conditional probability, arrays, tree diagrams, independence, factorials, arrangements and selections.

cards.title: Venn diagrams and two-way tables
cards.rule: \(A \cap B\): both. \(A \cup B\): either. \(A'\): not A.

fig.alt: Venn diagram: 12 in A only, 6 in both, 9 in B only, 3 in neither

cards.title: Conditional probability
cards.rule: \(P(A \mid B) = \dfrac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}\): only look inside B.
lines: From the Venn in card 2: \(P(A \mid B) = \tfrac{6}{15} = \tfrac25\)

cards.title: Arrays for two steps
cards.rule: List every outcome in a table.

cards.title: Tree diagrams
cards.rule: Multiply along the branches, add the branches you want.

cards.title: Independent events
cards.rule: Independent if \(P(A \cap B) = P(A) \times P(B)\), so \(P(A \mid B) = P(A)\).

cards.title: Counting and factorials
cards.rule: Multiply the number of choices at each step. \(n! = n \times (n - 1) \times \cdots \times 1\)
lines: 3 shirts and 4 pairs of pants: 3 × 4 = **12** outfits

cards.title: Selections
cards.tip: a team is a selection; a 1st, 2nd and 3rd place is an arrangement.

cards.title: Counting in probability
lines: Pick 3 from 5 boys and 4 girls: \(P(\text{all girls}) = \dfrac{{}^4C_3}{{}^9C_3} = \dfrac{4}{84} = \dfrac{1}{21}\)
